work: Yi I's Community and Household Compacts: Seowon and Haeju Hyangyak, Granary Asso
heading: 栗谷先生全書 卷十六 · 海州鄕約 · Haeju Community Compact (1577) · 海州鄕約 立約凡例 1 … 海州鄕約 德業相勸 1

items.text: Attend the monthly meetings on the first day of every other month; if unable due to illness or other cause, submit a written excuse before the meeting.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 立約凡例 1
items.quote: 同約之人。每閒一月朔日一會。 —— Fellow members meet on the first day of every other month.

items.text: Contribute the initial and annual funds for mutual aid: at the start, one bolt each of cotton and hemp cloth and one mal of rice; annually in the eleventh month, one mal of rice.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 立約凡例 1
items.quote: 各出綿布麻布各一疋米一斗... 每年十一月會時。同約各出米一斗。 —— Each contributes one bolt each of cotton and hemp cloth and one mal of rice... each year at the meeting in the eleventh month, each contributes one mal of rice.

items.text: Give congratulatory gifts for celebrations, the amount according to the occasion's importance.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 立約凡例 1
items.quote: 凡慶事有贈。以禮之大小。定幣之多少。 —— For all celebrations there are gifts; according to the rite's importance, the amount is set.

items.text: Provide funeral contributions and labor when a fellow member dies, or when the member's parent, wife, or child dies, with amounts and labor days set by the relation.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 立約凡例 1
items.quote: 凡喪事。有賻物。有助役。 —— For all funerals there are contributions and labor assistance.

items.text: If a fellow member's house is completely burned, contribute materials and a laborer for three days to help rebuild.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 立約凡例 1
items.quote: 凡失火。盡燒其家者。則同約僉議。裒蓋草各三編。材木各二條。且出壯奴一人。持三日糧。往助構屋之役。 — For fire that burns down a house, the members together gather thatch and timber, and send one able servant with three days' provisions to help rebuild.

items.text: If living in a distant village, send letters and gifts for celebrations and condolences, and contribute one bolt of cotton cloth every three years and one bolt of hemp cloth every three years in place of annual rice contributions.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 立約凡例 1
items.quote: 同約居異鄕者。則不能於每年出米斗。只於三年出綿布一疋。又三年出麻布一疋。 —— Those living in other villages cannot contribute rice annually, but every three years contribute one bolt of cotton cloth and every three years one bolt of hemp cloth.

items.text: The direct month (officer) must investigate and record the good and bad deeds of fellow members and report them at the meeting; failure to do so is an offense.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 立約凡例 1
items.quote: 直月若聞同約善惡之行。則細詢得實。私作簿記。於會日衆中告之。 —— If the direct month hears of members' good or bad deeds, he inquires thoroughly, records them privately, and reports to all at the meeting.

items.text: Be filial to your parents.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 德業相勸 1
items.quote: 孝於父母 —— be filial to parents

items.text: Be fraternal and affectionate to your brothers.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 德業相勸 1
items.quote: 友于兄弟 —— be friendly to brothers

items.text: Be deferential to elders and superiors.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 德業相勸 1
items.quote: 弟于長上 —— be deferential to elders and superiors

items.text: Teach your children with proper methods.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 德業相勸 1
items.quote: 敎子有方 —— teach children with proper method

items.text: Perform ancestral sacrifices with full sincerity.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 德業相勸 1
items.quote: 祭盡其誠 —— in sacrifices be fully sincere

work: Yi I's Community and Household Compacts: Seowon and Haeju Hyangyak, Granary Asso
heading: 栗谷先生全書 卷十六 · 西原鄕約 · Seowon Community Compact (1571) · 西原鄕約 立議 1 … 西原鄕約 鄕會讀約法 6

items.text: Be filial to your parents.
items.citation: Yi I, Seowon Community Compact, 立議 1-鄕會讀約法 6
items.quote: 能孝父母 — Be filial to one's parents.

items.text: Be friendly to your brothers and sisters.
items.citation: Yi I, Seowon Community Compact, 立議 1-鄕會讀約法 6
items.quote: 能友兄弟 — Be friendly to brothers.

items.text: Maintain harmony with your relatives.
items.citation: Yi I, Seowon Community Compact, 立議 1-鄕會讀約法 6
items.quote: 能睦親故 — Be able to live in harmony with relatives.

items.text: Teach your children righteousness.
items.citation: Yi I, Seowon Community Compact, 立議 1-鄕會讀約法 6
items.quote: 能以義訓子弟 — Be able to instruct the young with righteousness.

items.text: Be kind to your children.
items.citation: Yi I, Seowon Community Compact, 立議 1-鄕會讀約法 6
items.quote: 不慈 — do not be unkind to children.

items.text: Respect your elder brother.
items.citation: Yi I, Seowon Community Compact, 立議 1-鄕會讀約法 6
items.quote: 不悌 — do not be disrespectful to elder brothers.

items.text: Maintain the proper distinction between husband and wife.
items.citation: Yi I, Seowon Community Compact, 立議 1-鄕會讀約法 6
items.quote: 夫婦無別 — no distinction between husband and wife; maintain it.

items.text: Do not neglect or mistreat your primary wife.
items.citation: Yi I, Seowon Community Compact, 立議 1-鄕會讀約法 6
items.quote: 疏薄正妻 — do not treat the primary wife coldly or lightly.

items.text: Perform the ancestral rites with reverence; do not be negligent in the sacrificial services.
items.citation: Yi I, Seowon Community Compact, 立議 1-鄕會讀約法 6
items.quote: 不敬祀事 — not reverent in sacrificial rites; be reverent.

items.text: Show genuine grief when attending a funeral.
items.citation: Yi I, Seowon Community Compact, 立議 1-鄕會讀約法 6
items.quote: 臨喪不哀 — not sorrowful when attending funerals; be sorrowful.

items.text: Do not treat your elders with contempt.
items.citation: Yi I, Seowon Community Compact, 立議 1-鄕會讀約法 6
items.quote: 少陵長 — the young insult the elders; do not.

items.text: At gatherings for a funeral, set out no cups or plates and drink no wine.
items.citation: Yi I, Seowon Community Compact, 立議 1-鄕會讀約法 6
items.quote: 凡干喪事聚會時。毋得設杯盤飮酒 — At funeral gatherings, do not set out cups or drink wine.

work: Yi I's Community and Household Compacts: Seowon and Haeju Hyangyak, Granary Asso
heading: 栗谷先生全書 卷十六 · 海州鄕約 · Haeju Community Compact (1577) · 海州鄕約 禮俗相交 38 … 海州鄕約 禮俗相交 82

items.text: When an elder comes to your house, send word beforehand, dress properly, come out to meet him, bow, and escort him out to see him off.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 禮俗相交 38-82
items.quote: 尊者至幼者之家。則先遣人預通。主人具衣冠。出中門以俟。 — When an elder comes to a younger's house, first send someone to give notice; the host, in proper dress, goes out to the gate to wait.

items.text: Bow always when you see a superior; greet an elder with a respectful clasped-hands bow.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 禮俗相交 38-82
items.quote: 凡見尊者。必拜。見長者必恭揖。 — When seeing a superior, always bow; when seeing an elder, always bow with clasped hands.

items.text: When attending an elder and a guest arrives, do not rise to greet the guest if the elder does not rise; when the guest enters, let him bow to the elder first.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 禮俗相交 38-82
items.quote: 侍尊長坐。客至。尊長不起則亦不起。 — When attending an elder and a guest comes, if the elder does not rise, do not rise either.

items.text: On the road, yield to elders: if on foot, hasten forward to bow; if on horseback, dismount and wait until they have passed.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 禮俗相交 38-82
items.quote: 凡遇尊長於道。皆徒行則趨進以拜。 — When meeting an elder on the road, if both on foot, hasten forward to bow.

items.text: When inviting an elder to eat, go personally to invite him with a written list; do not invite an elder only as an afterthought to a banquet for another guest.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 禮俗相交 38-82
items.quote: 凡請尊者飮食。必具單子。親往以請。 — When inviting a superior to eat, prepare a written list and go personally to invite.

items.text: When a member goes far away or returns from afar, gather with others to send him off or welcome him with food and drink.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 禮俗相交 38-82
items.quote: 凡遠出及自遠而歸。則有送迎之禮。 — For those going far or returning from afar, there is a rite of send-off and welcome.

items.text: Congratulate fellow members on happy occasions, give gifts, and help them with expenses and labor for weddings and celebrations.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 禮俗相交 38-82
items.quote: 凡同約。有吉事則慶之。... 有贈物。 — When a fellow member has a happy occasion, congratulate him and give gifts.

items.text: When a fellow member suffers a disaster or death, condole with him personally or by letter, and help as needed.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 禮俗相交 38-82
items.quote: 有凶聖則弔之。 — When there is misfortune, condole.

items.text: On hearing of a death in a member's household, go to the house to mourn and condole, and help with funeral arrangements.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 禮俗相交 38-82
items.quote: 若喪事則聞喪卽時。直月周告同約。往哭弔。 — If there is a funeral, upon hearing the news, the rotating officer informs all members to go and weep and condole.

items.text: At a fellow member's funeral, set out offerings and libations at the spirit seat, bow, and mourn for the dead.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 禮俗相交 38-82
items.quote: 同約之喪。有致奠。 — For a fellow member's funeral, there is an offering.
items.conflict: Offering food and libations to the dead is ancestor veneration; the dead cannot be prayed to.

items.text: Attend the burial of a fellow member.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 禮俗相交 38-82
items.quote: 及葬。齊進會葬。 — At the burial, go together to attend the funeral.

work: Yi I's Community and Household Compacts: Seowon and Haeju Hyangyak, Granary Asso
heading: 栗谷先生全書 卷十六 · 社倉契約束 · Rules of the Granary Association · 社倉契約束 立約凡例 1 … 社倉契約束 過失相規 29

items.text: Love your parents sincerely: give them the best food, obey their wishes, spend your wealth for them, and care for them diligently in sickness.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Association, 社倉契約束 立約凡例 1–過失相規 29
items.quote: 實心愛親。所得甘旨。皆以奉親。承順其志。不敢違逆。父母有病。憂念不弛。必求其藥。盡心救療。

items.text: Mourn your parents deeply at death, observe the mourning period, and offer sacrifices to them with sincerity.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Association, 社倉契約束 立約凡例 1–過失相規 29
items.quote: 臨喪盡哀。守制以禮。祭祀以誠。父母忌日。書紙榜以祭。四名日祭于墓。

items.text: Love your siblings as your own body: share food and goods with them, and help each other in all things.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Association, 社倉契約束 立約凡例 1–過失相規 29
items.quote: 同生相愛。有無相通。所得飮食。必與分食。凡事相救助。無異一身。

items.text: Respect one another: do not quarrel, and avoid both excessive familiarity and cold distance.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Association, 社倉契約束 立約凡例 1–過失相規 29
items.quote: 夫妻相敬。不相鬪詰。且不昵狎。亦不疏薄。

items.text: Teach your children good behavior, make them diligent in work, and if they quarrel with others, discipline them without partiality.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Association, 社倉契約束 立約凡例 1–過失相規 29
items.quote: 敎子必以善行。使之修身勤事。不敢嬉遊。若與人相詰。則勿論曲直。必撻詬其子。

items.text: Love your relatives: share what you have, lend and borrow, and help one another in sickness and hardship.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Association, 社倉契約束 立約凡例 1–過失相規 29
items.quote: 愛族黨。和鄰里。有無相假貸。疾病患難。相救助。

items.text: Honor your uncles: do not speak rudely to them, do not argue or insult them, and show respect in their presence.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Association, 社倉契約束 立約凡例 1–過失相規 29
items.quote: 叱辱三寸叔父及同生兄者。與三寸叔父及同生兄。變色相詰者。三寸叔父及兄所見處踞坐者。騎牛馬過者。言辭不恭者。

items.text: Honor your parents-in-law: a wife must treat her husband's parents as her own parents, and a husband must treat his wife's parents as his maternal uncles.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Association, 社倉契約束 立約凡例 1–過失相規 29
items.quote: 凡舅姑同於父母。（妻父母同於外三寸）

items.text: Serve your master sincerely: obey his orders promptly, do not deceive or cheat him, and show respect in his presence.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Association, 社倉契約束 立約凡例 1–過失相規 29
items.quote: 事上典以誠。不敢少有欺隱。有所使令。奔走服役。不憚勤苦。不順從上典之敎令者。行上典之令而凡事不直。欺罔取利者。

items.text: Do not strike your wife without just cause; if you injure her, you will be punished more severely.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Association, 社倉契約束 立約凡例 1–過失相規 29
items.quote: 無罪而打妻者。中罰。傷打者則上罰。

items.text: Do not strike your husband, and do not scold him in public.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Association, 社倉契約束 立約凡例 1–過失相規 29
items.quote: 下人妻打夫者。上罰。傷打則告官。妻於衆中罵夫者。中罰。

items.text: If your parent has committed a fault, offer yourself as his child to receive the punishment in his place.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Association, 社倉契約束 立約凡例 1–過失相規 29
items.quote: 凡尊者有過。則使子弟代受其罰。

work: Yi I's Community and Household Compacts: Seowon and Haeju Hyangyak, Granary Asso
heading: 栗谷先生全書 卷十六 · 社倉契約束 · Rules of the Granary Association · 社倉契約束 社倉法 1 … 社倉契約束 會時坐次 2

items.text: If a close kinsman not in the compact asks for grain, receive it in your own name and press for repayment; if he cannot pay, pay it yourself.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Association Rules, 社倉法 1
items.quote: 若有切親...未參契而有求食者。則契員自以其名受糶。秋後自督以納。未納則契員自備以納 — If a close kinsman borrows, the member receives in his own name; if not repaid, the member pays.

items.text: If a servant not in the compact asks for grain, receive it in your own name and press for repayment; if he cannot pay, pay it yourself.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Association Rules, 社倉法 1
items.quote: 若有切親及奴僕。未參契而有求食者。則契員自以其名受糶。秋後自督以納。未納則契員自備以納 — If a kinsman or servant borrows, the member receives in his own name; if not repaid, the member pays.

items.text: Arrive early and wait for your elders; do not make them wait for you.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Association Rules, 會時坐次 2
items.quote: 少者當先往 — The young should go first.

items.text: If you attend the association meeting to observe etiquette, bring wine and fruit; then you may sit in your proper place.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Association Rules, 會時坐次 2
items.quote: 凡契員子弟...若欲參會觀禮。則亦持壺果來參 — If a member's son wants to observe, he must bring wine and fruit.

items.text: Serve the eldest first; give him the first portion before serving others.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Association Rules, 會時坐次 2
items.quote: 果先進于尊位 — Fruit is served first to the honored seat.

items.text: Stand and bow to the elders when you enter the gathering.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Association Rules, 會時坐次 2
items.quote: 下人列立。再拜 — Servants stand and bow.

work: Yi I's Community and Household Compacts: Seowon and Haeju Hyangyak, Granary Asso
heading: 栗谷先生全書 卷十六 · 海州一鄕約束 · Rules for the Whole Haeju District · 海州一鄕約束 1 … 海州一鄕約束 32

items.text: Be kind and gentle to your children.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 1-32
items.quote: 父慈 — father be kind

items.text: Be filial to your parents; honor and serve them.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 1-32
items.quote: 子孝 — child be filial

items.text: Be a friend to your younger brothers; show them kindness.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 1-32
items.quote: 兄友 — elder brother friendly

items.text: Respect your elder brothers; treat them with deference.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 1-32
items.quote: 弟恭 — younger brother respectful

items.text: Respect your wife; do not treat her as inferior.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 1-32
items.quote: 夫妻相敬 — husband and wife respect each other

items.text: Respect your husband; give him due honor.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 1-32
items.quote: 夫妻相敬 — husband and wife respect each other

items.text: Keep the order of elders and juniors; give way to those above you.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 1-32
items.quote: 長幼有序 — elders and juniors in order

items.text: Love your children and provide for them so they are not left without a place.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 1-32
items.quote: 父不愛子。使不得所者 — father not loving son, causing him to have no place

items.text: Do not let fondness for a concubine cause you to neglect your innocent wife.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 1-32
items.quote: 溺愛姬妾。疏薄無罪正妻者 — doting on concubine, neglecting innocent wife

items.text: Do not insult or revile your elders.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 1-32
items.quote: 以少陵長。至於詬辱者 — young insulting elder, to revile

items.text: Live in harmony with your brothers; avoid discord.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 1-32
items.quote: 兄弟不和 — brothers not harmonious

items.text: When your parents die, bury them with proper rites and mourning.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 1-32
items.quote: 鄕員四喪。（父母己妻）初喪時出回文。各收合米一升。送于其家。 — For the four mourning affairs of members (parents, self, wife), at the beginning of mourning, send a circular and each collect a measure of rice to send to the house.

work: Yi I's Community and Household Compacts: Seowon and Haeju Hyangyak, Granary Asso
heading: 栗谷先生全書 卷十六 · 社倉契約束 · Rules of the Granary Association · 社倉契約束 過失相規 30 … 社倉契約束 患難相恤 10

items.text: Instruct her so that she does not do evil.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Asso, 過失相規 30
items.quote: 不能敎其妻子。使作惡者 — If he cannot teach his wife and children, causing them to do evil

items.text: Instruct your children so that they do not do evil.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Asso, 過失相規 30
items.quote: 不能敎其妻子。使作惡者 — If he cannot teach his wife and children, causing them to do evil

items.text: Do not neglect or treat coldly your proper wife.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Asso, 過失相規 30
items.quote: 疏薄正妻者 — one who neglects his proper wife

items.text: Be harmonious with your relatives; do not fight or quarrel.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Asso, 過失相規 30
items.quote: 不能睦族。相與鬪詰者 — cannot live in harmony with relatives but fight and quarrel with them

items.text: Honor your elders: dismount when you meet those twenty years older, bow to those ten years older.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Asso, 患難相恤 10
items.quote: 凡長於我二十歲以上則爲尊者。十歲以上則爲長者。路中遇同契尊者則下馬 — Those twenty years older are respected; ten years older are elders; when meeting a respected one on the road, dismount

items.text: Do not lead your child into heresy or superstitious rites.
items.citation: Yi I, Granary Asso, 過失相規 30
items.quote: 崇信異端。好行淫祀者。次上罰。若有父母。不能自斷者。勿論 — Those who believe heresies and practice improper sacrifices receive punishment; but if they have parents and cannot decide for themselves, they are not punished

work: Yi I's Community and Household Compacts: Seowon and Haeju Hyangyak, Granary Asso
heading: 栗谷先生全書 卷十六 · 海州鄕約 · Haeju Community Compact (1577) · 海州鄕約 會集讀約法 22 … 海州鄕約 會集讀約法 30

items.text: Bow to your superiors at the assembly in the order prescribed, and receive their answering bow.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 會集讀約法 22-30
items.quote: 約正以下再拜。（此約正拜尊者也）尊者答拜。 — Those below the compact head bow twice; the elders answer the bow.

items.text: Receive the bow of your juniors and answer it in return.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 會集讀約法 22-30
items.quote: 尊者答拜。 — The elders answer the bow.

items.text: Bow to your equals when you meet in the assembly.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 會集讀約法 22-30
items.quote: 敵者於西壁下北上。東向敍立於長者之南。東向再拜。（此敵者相拜） — The equals bow to one another.

items.text: Take the seat proper to your rank and generation; do not sit above your station.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 會集讀約法 22-30
items.quote: 長者敵者少者。坐于西壁。 — Elders, equals, and juniors sit by the west wall.

items.text: Listen attentively while the compact is read; if something is unclear, ask for an explanation.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 會集讀約法 22-30
items.quote: 未達者。許其質問。 — Those who do not understand may ask questions.

items.text: Before recording a fault, verify the facts with the assembly; do not act on one person's word.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 會集讀約法 22-30
items.quote: 約正詢其實狀于衆。無異辭。乃命直月書于籍。 — The compact head asks the assembly for the facts; if there is no dissent, he orders it written.

items.text: Accept correction for your faults and the recording of your deeds without resentment.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 會集讀約法 22-30
items.quote: 有過者直月糾之。 — Those with faults are corrected by the monthly officer.

items.text: In discussion, speak only of what is beneficial; do not utter superstitious, heterodox, seditious, or slanderous words.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 會集讀約法 22-30
items.quote: 講論須有益之事。不得輒道神怪邪僻悖亂之言及私議朝廷州縣政事得失及揚人過惡。 — Discussion must be useful; do not speak of spirits, heterodoxies, sedition, or expose others' faults.

items.text: Sit upright, face forward, and do not lean, look around, or laugh carelessly.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 會集讀約法 22-30
items.quote: 諸位皆拱手端坐。莊色正視。不得傾倚回顧。放言恣笑。 — All sit with hands folded, upright, gaze straight forward; do not lean, look around, or laugh freely.

items.text: When you must leave before dismissal, bow low from your place; when an elder or the leader leaves, everyone bows low.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 會集讀約法 22-30
items.quote: 如因事起出。則當出位俯伏。 — If you must leave, bow low from your place.

items.text: At the end of the assembly, bow from your place and let your elders go out first before you depart.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact (1577), 會集讀約法 22-30
items.quote: 散時。在位者皆起立。因其位皆再拜。拜畢。一時作揖。尊者以下以次皆出。然後約正以下乃出。 — At dismissal all stand and bow; the elders leave in order, then the compact head and below leave.

work: Yi I's Community and Household Compacts: Seowon and Haeju Hyangyak, Granary Asso
heading: 栗谷先生全書 卷十六 · 〔附〕同居戒辭 · Admonitions for Living Together as One Household (originally in Korean script; Chinese rendering by 宋時烈) · 同居戒辭 1 … 同居戒辭 11

items.text: Love one another as one body; share property and live together, do not separate.
items.citation: Yi I, Admonitions for Living Together as One Household, §1
items.quote: 兄弟...宜相親愛。少無彼此物我之心也。...同財而居。莫相分離。 — Brothers... ought to love one another without selfishness... share possessions and live together; do not separate.

items.text: Set aside first for the ancestral rite and serve with utmost sincerity that the spirits may accept.
items.citation: Yi I, Admonitions for Living Together as One Household, §2
items.quote: 凡有所得。必先收藏。以爲祭祀之需。不得妄爲他用。且當祭祀之時。必極其誠心。齋潔身體。必期於先靈之歆饗也。 — Whatever is gained, first store it for ancestral rites; do not use it otherwise. At the rite, be utmost sincere, purify body, hoping the spirits accept.
items.conflict: Offering to the dead conflicts with Deut 18:11; the dead cannot receive (Luke 16:31).

items.text: Serve your parents according to the ancient sages' teaching and fulfill filial piety.
items.citation: Yi I, Admonitions for Living Together as One Household, §3
items.quote: 凡少輩事父母者。必以古聖人所訓爲心。以致其孝也。 — All juniors serving parents must take ancient sages' teachings to heart to achieve filial piety.

items.text: Revere the widowed head of the family as you would your own mother.
items.citation: Yi I, Admonitions for Living Together as One Household, §4
items.quote: 吾丘嫂。是一家之長。祭祀之主。凡爲其下者。特致恭敬。待之如待母。可也。 — Our eldest brother's wife is head of the family and mistress of rites; all under her must show utmost respect, treating her like a mother.

items.text: Be utterly respectful and obedient to the wife.
items.citation: Yi I, Admonitions for Living Together as One Household, §7
items.quote: 妾則極其恭順 — The concubine must be extremely respectful and obedient.

items.text: Rise when an elder passes and keep a respectful heart.
items.citation: Yi I, Admonitions for Living Together as One Household, §8
items.quote: 凡家衆坐而執事之時。長者過。則須卽起立。大凡操心。常以恭順爲則。 — When sitting at tasks, if an elder passes, rise; keep a respectful, obedient mind.

items.text: Serve your uncles with the same rites as you serve your father.
items.citation: Yi I, Admonitions for Living Together as One Household, §9
items.quote: 凡於叔父則如事父之禮 — toward uncles, use the rites for serving a father.

items.text: Do not abuse servants; admonish gently and hand over punishment to the head.
items.citation: Yi I, Admonitions for Living Together as One Household, §10
items.quote: 婢僕雖有不善。亦勿高聲詬詈。須溫言敎戒。不聽然後。告于家長而責罰之。少者雖其私使奴僕。亦勿輕加捶撻。須告于家長。 — Even if servants err, do not shout; admonish gently, then report to the head; young masters must not beat even private servants; tell the head.

items.text: Love your child.
items.citation: Yi I, Admonitions for Living Together as One Household, §11
items.quote: 父則愛子 — The father should love his child.

items.text: Be a righteous model to your wife.
items.citation: Yi I, Admonitions for Living Together as One Household, §11
items.quote: 夫則刑妻 — The husband should set an example for his wife.

items.text: Respect your husband.
items.citation: Yi I, Admonitions for Living Together as One Household, §11
items.quote: 妻則敬夫 — The wife should respect her husband.

items.text: Be obedient to your elder brother.
items.citation: Yi I, Admonitions for Living Together as One Household, §11
items.quote: 弟順其兄 — The younger brother should obey his elder brother.

work: Yi I's Community and Household Compacts: Seowon and Haeju Hyangyak, Granary Asso
heading: 栗谷先生全書 卷十六 · 海州一鄕約束 · Rules for the Whole Haeju District · 海州一鄕約束 33 … 海州一鄕約束 鄕會讀約法 1

items.text: If a member is about to be punished without cause, stand together in the courtyard and present a written plea to save him; do the same for any serious grievance of the people.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 33
items.quote: 鄕員以非罪。將受刑戮者。僉議立庭。呈單子救解之。 — When a member is about to be punished unjustly, all deliberate and stand in the courtyard and present a plea to save him.

items.text: The hyangso must inspect and correct the conduct of clerks and officials; if any abuse their power, harm the people, or insult a gentleman, report them to the magistrate for punishment.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 33
items.quote: 鄕所專掌糾檢吏民風俗。若有鄕吏書員輩官屬。汎濫用事。作弊民閒。及陵辱品官者。則告官治罪。 — The hyangso is to inspect and correct the customs of officials and people; if clerks abuse power, harm the people, or insult gentlemen, report them to the magistrate for punishment.
items.needs_role: hyangso members (鄕所); people of the district (民)

items.text: If the magistrate will not believe the hyangso and the clerks' crime is grave, the whole district must gather and stand in the courtyard to demand punishment.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 33
items.quote: 若城主不信鄕所之言。而吏輩官屬之罪關重。則一鄕齊會。立庭請罪。 — If the magistrate does not believe the hyangso and the clerks' crime is grave, the whole district assembles and stands in the courtyard to request punishment.

items.text: When someone is recommended for membership, inquire of all whether he may enter; admit him only with common consent, and if he is known fit but unwilling, compel him by public decision; do not require an entrance gift.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 33
items.quote: 可參鄕員者。於會集時薦擧。通問可否。以爲可入然後許入。若衆所共知可入。而非自己願入。以公議勒入者。則勿問可否。除後入禮。 — Recommend candidates at meetings, ask all whether they may enter; admit only with consent; if known fit but unwilling, compel by public decision; no entrance gift.
items.needs_role: hyang members (鄕員); candidate for hyang membership

items.text: After collecting grain or sending condolence relief, the officer must present the replies to the assembly for review.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 33
items.quote: 凡收合米升。致賻周急等事旣畢。有司須以回文及答狀。呈于衆會處。 — When collecting rice or sending condolence or relief is done, the officer must present the replies to the assembly.
items.needs_role: officer (有司); assembly of hyang members

items.text: If a clerk or official is rude or insulting before you, write a notice and send it to the hyangso so they may judge the offense.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 33
items.quote: 凡鄕吏書員官人等。若品官前。或無禮。或陵辱。則品官具書單子。送呈于鄕所。 — If clerks or officials are rude or insulting before a gentleman, the gentleman writes a single notice and sends it to the hyangso.

items.text: When such a notice comes, deliberate the gravity of the offense, flog the offender, and then report to the hyangheon; if you neglect it, you will be punished at the assembly.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 33
items.quote: 所員僉議罪犯輕重。笞罰後。告于鄕憲。若所員棄置不論罪。則鄕會時。所員致罰事。 — The members deliberate the gravity, flog, then report to hyangheon; if they neglect, they are punished at the assembly.

items.text: Do not decide public matters on your own; bring them to the hyangheon to settle, and then report.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 33
items.quote: 公事所員不敢自斷。稟于鄕憲成公事。報狀事。 — In public matters the members dare not decide alone; they consult the hyangheon to complete the matter, then report.
items.needs_role: hyangso members (鄕所); hyangheon (local head, 鄕憲)

items.text: For head clerk positions, always select the honest and careful; if someone obtains such a post by underhanded means, do not allow him to act in office.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 33
items.quote: 鄕吏中選擇淸謹吏。置簿勸善。上戶長吏房。必以淸謹者。備望差定。若有他岐圖得者。勿許行公事。 — Among clerks choose the honest and careful, record them to encourage good; for head clerk posts always appoint the honest; if anyone obtains it by other means, do not let him act.
items.needs_role: hyangso members (鄕所); people of the district

items.text: Keep a register of the good and evil deeds of clerks and officials and present it at the spring and autumn assemblies.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 33
items.quote: 凡鄕吏書員官人等。善惡籍置簿冊。春秋講信時進呈事。 — For clerks, keep a register of good and evil deeds, present it at spring and autumn assemblies.
items.needs_role: hyangso members (鄕所); assembly of hyang members

items.text: When a gentleman of the district dies, collect condolence rice and paper and send them to his house by a dedicated messenger.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 33
items.quote: 凡一鄕品官喪事時。收合賻米及賻紙等物。專人輸送後。同宅答狀。 — At a gentleman's funeral, collect condolence rice and paper, send by a dedicated person; the house replies.
items.needs_role: hyang members (鄕員); family of the deceased gentleman

items.text: At the assembly, bow twice to the hyangheon and to those of seventy years and above, and while the compact is read, listen with clasped hands and a composed face.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 鄕會讀約法 1
items.quote: 鄕憲先就北壁南向立。座首以下及副憲。就前北向。行再拜禮。鄕憲答拜。...副憲抗聲讀約束。坐中皆拱手整容以聽。 — The hyangheon stands facing south; the others face north and bow twice; the deputy reads the compact aloud; all sit with hands clasped and composed faces to listen.
items.needs_role: hyangheon and elders over seventy (鄕憲及七十以上尊者)

work: Yi I's Community and Household Compacts: Seowon and Haeju Hyangyak, Granary Asso
heading: 栗谷先生全書 卷十六 · 海州鄕約 · Haeju Community Compact (1577) · 海州鄕約 禮俗相交 83 … 海州鄕約 會集讀約法 21

items.text: When a senior dies, send your sons and younger brothers to attend the funeral.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 禮俗相交
items.quote: 尊者則使子弟會葬 — When a senior dies, have your sons and younger brothers attend the funeral.

items.text: Weep for a young person who has died, but do not bow.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 禮俗相交
items.quote: 幼者之喪。則尊者哭而不拜。 — At the funeral of a young person, elders weep but do not bow.

items.text: If orphaned children have means, their reliable kin must manage the household and audit its accounts.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 患難相恤 5
items.quote: 擇其親族之忠信幹事者。使區處。考其出納。 — Choose reliable kin to manage and audit the household's income and expenses.

items.text: If the orphan's household cannot support itself, help them together so they do not lose their place.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 患難相恤 5
items.quote: 同約協力濟之。無令失所。 — Help together so they do not lose their place.

items.text: If anyone bullies them, plead their cause and defend them.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 患難相恤 5
items.quote: 若有侵欺之者。則衆人力爲之辨理。 — If anyone bullies them, the members should plead their cause.

items.text: As the orphan grows, choose teachers and seek a marriage partner for him.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 患難相恤 5
items.quote: 若其子稍長。則擇人敎之。且爲求婚姻。 — When the child grows, choose teachers and seek a marriage partner.

items.text: If the orphan is dissolute, watch over him and restrain him, so that he does not fall into unrighteousness.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 患難相恤 5
items.quote: 若放逸不檢。則亦防察約束之。無令陷於不義。 — If he is dissolute, watch and restrain him so he does not fall into unrighteousness.

items.text: Open the shrine of Wenxian Gong, sweep it, set out incense burner and box, and offer incense and bows.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 會集讀約法
items.quote: 文憲公廟。亦開門灑掃。設香鑪香合。...行焚香。先後再拜禮 — Open the shrine of Wenxian Gong, sweep it, set out incense, and offer incense and bows.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment and the prohibition of idolatrous worship.

items.text: When a household is all sick and cannot farm, help by sending servants and oxen to plow.
items.citation: Haeju Hyangyak, 患難相恤 3
items.quote: 若闔家臥病。不能耕耘。則同約協力出奴及牛耕耘。 — If a whole household is sick and cannot farm, members send servants and oxen to plow.

work: Yi I's Community and Household Compacts: Seowon and Haeju Hyangyak, Granary Asso
heading: 栗谷先生全書 卷十六 · 海州鄕約 · Haeju Community Compact (1577) · 海州鄕約 德業相勸 2 … 海州鄕約 禮俗相交 37

items.text: Govern your household with discipline and order.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact, 德業相勸 2
items.quote: 能肅家政 — be able to govern the household strictly.

items.text: Love each other with restraint, neither overly familiar nor cold and distant.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact, 犯義之過 3
items.quote: 夫妻太昵，或太疏薄 — husband and wife too intimate, or too distant.

items.text: If your parents do not reject heterodox practices, remonstrate with them to stop; if they will not listen, you are not at fault.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact, 犯義之過 6
items.quote: 一家若有父母不斥左道，則子當諫止 — if parents do not reject left ways, the son should remonstrate and stop them.

items.text: Do not allow improper sacrifices in your household; prohibit them.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact, 犯義之過 6
items.quote: 一家崇尙淫祀而不之禁 — a family upholds improper sacrifices and does not forbid them.

items.text: Bury your deceased parents without delay.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact, 犯義之過 6
items.quote: 過期不葬 — delaying burial beyond the proper time.

items.text: Do not move the graves of your ancestors for geomantic reasons.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact, 犯義之過 6
items.quote: 惑於術家風水之說，妄移葬先墓 — deluded by geomancers' talk, improperly move ancestral graves.
items.conflict: Deuteronomy 18:10-12 forbids divination and consulting spirits.

items.text: Do not abandon the ancestral rites because of illness such as smallpox.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact, 犯義之過 6
items.quote: 因瘡疹廢祀 — because of smallpox, abandon the rites.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment and the prohibition of necromancy (Deut 18:11).

items.text: When your parent or elder brother sends you, go in his place to convey his congratulations or thanks.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact, 禮俗相交
items.quote: 使子弟具己名銜，代報其禮 — send son or younger brother with his name card to report the courtesy on his behalf.

items.text: Go to pay your respects at New Year, bid farewell before a long journey, greet upon return, offer congratulations on happy occasions, and express thanks in person for visits or gifts.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact, 禮俗相交
items.quote: 幼者於尊者，歲首之拜及辭見賀謝，皆爲禮見 — the young toward the honored, New Year's bow, farewell, greeting, congratulations, thanks, all are formal visits.

items.text: Return ritual courtesies to your juniors: if you are of the highest elder rank, send a letter of congratulations; if a lesser elder, visit in person at New Year and on happy occasions.
items.citation: Haeju Community Compact, 禮俗相交
items.quote: 尊者受謁不報，有慶則貽書賀之；長者於歲首親往報之 — the honored receives visits without returning them, but sends a letter of congratulations; the elder at New Year goes in person to return the visit.
